module_summary: One shift-register stage: a flop Q loads parallel value R when L is high, otherwise shifts in w from the previous stage when E is high.

anchors.name: Q
anchors.why: Shift-register stage flop, loaded from R or shifted from w

anchors.name: L
anchors.why: Load select: chooses parallel R over shift input, priority over E

anchors.name: E
anchors.why: Shift enable updating Q with w

anchors.name: w
anchors.why: Serial input from previous shift-register stage

anchors.name: R
anchors.why: Parallel load value written into Q when L asserted

groups.name: shift_stage
groups.description: Load/shift multiplexer feeding single stage flop Q
